decisions.title: update_plan Is a Tool, Not a Hidden Planner
decisions.description: Planning enters the same tool dispatch path as shell or apply_patch. This keeps the plan visible and lets the model decide when to update it. The harness stores the current checklist; the model rewrites it as work progresses.
decisions.alternatives: An automatic planner could write the plan behind the scenes, but the user would not see when the model's intent changed.

zh.title: update_plan 是工具，不是隐藏规划器
zh.description: 规划通过和 shell、apply_patch 相同的工具分发路径进入系统。这样计划状态可见，模型也能决定何时更新。harness 保存当前清单，模型随工作推进重写它。

decisions.title: A Lightweight Reminder Prevents Plan Drift
decisions.description: After several rounds without an update_plan call, the runtime injects a reminder. The reminder nudges the model without taking over the plan.
decisions.alternatives: Forcing a plan update every turn would be noisy and slow down simple tasks.

zh.title: 轻量提醒防止计划漂移
zh.description: 多个回合没有调用 update_plan 后，运行时会注入提醒。它只提醒模型，不接管计划。

decisions.title: The Plan Stays Session-Local
decisions.description: update_plan is for the current session's working plan, not durable project management. Later task systems handle persistent work.
decisions.alternatives: Persisting every step immediately would blur the difference between a scratch plan and a durable task graph.

zh.title: 计划保持会话内状态
zh.description: update_plan 面向当前会话的工作计划，不是持久项目管理。后面的任务系统负责持久工作。
